title: Occupancy classification for supportive living accommodations under the Safety Codes Act and NBC(AE)
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 (National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: December 2025 (platform created December 5, 2025, last updated December 5, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies how the Safety Codes Act and NBC(AE) apply to determine the occupancy classification of buildings for clients receiving different levels of supportive living.
Supportive living residences regulated under continuing-care regulations may be classified as a Group B, Division 3 care occupancy or a Group C residential occupancy.
An assessment by a Case Manager or Health Care Professional is required in the decision process for placing a patient, client or resident.
